sections.section: RULE - National Security Council Secretariat Rules 2004
sections.description:
NATIONAL SECURITY COUNCIL SECRETARIAT RULES, 2004
NATIONAL SECURITY
COUNCIL SECRETARIAT RULES, 2004
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part II, 31st August, 2004]
S.R.O. 744(I)/2004, dated 20‑7‑2004.
‑In exercise of the powers conferred by section 8 of the National
Security Council Act, 2004 (I of 2004), the following rules are made by the
National Security Council for carrying out the purposes of the aforesaid Act.
1. Short title and
commencement.‑(1) These rules may be called the National Security
Council Secretariat Rules, 2004.
(2) They shall come into force at
once.
2. Definitions.‑(1)
In these rules, unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or context:‑‑
(a)
"Act" means the National Security Council Act, 2004 (L of 2004).
(b)
"Government" means the Federal Government.
(c)
"Secretariat" means the National Security Council Secretariat; and.
(d)
"Secretary" means the Secretary of the Council.
(2) All words and expressions
used but not defined in these rules shall have the same meanings as are
assigned, to them under, the Act.
3. Strength of the Secretariat.‑(1)
NSC Secretariat shall have such permanent or temporary posts and in such scales‑
of pay as may, from lime to time, be sanctioned by the Chairman in addition to
the existing strength of permanent and.' temporary posts specified in the
Schedule annexed hereto.
(2) The Chairman may, by order in
writing, direct that his powers under sub‑rule‑1 may, in such
circumstances and under such conditions, if any, as may be specified in the
direction, be exercisable also by the Secretary NSC.
4. Scale of pay and other
emoluments.‑(1) The posts in the Secretariat shall carry the same pay
or scale of pay and other emoluments, and the persons appointed to such posts
shall have the same status and terms and, condition of.' service, as are, for the
time being applicable to the corresponding posts in the Federal. Secretariat
and the persons appointed thereto.
(2) Any post in the office of the
NSC Secretariat which is not corresponding to a post under the Government shall
carry such pay or scale of pay and other emoluments and the persons appointed
to such posts shall have such terms' and conditions of service as may be
prescribed by the Chairman or a person authorized by him in that behalf.
5. Methods, of appointment.‑Appointment
to a posts or class of post may be made by one or more of the following,
methods, namely:‑‑
(a) by promotion
of a person employed in the NSC Secretariat;
(b) by transfer
or deputation from amongst the persons holding appointments 'on a regular basis
in the same grade in which the posts to be filled exists;
(c) by direct
recruitment;
(d) NSC
Secretariat may hire services of experts on terms and conditions as may be
approved by the Chairman of the Council on case to case basis.
6. Qualification and
experience for appointment.---‑The qualifications and experience for
appointment to the various categories of posts shall be the same as are
applicable and prescribed for the employees of the Federal Government from time
to time.
7. Terms and conditions of
service.‑The rides and orders applicable to civil servants of
corresponding posts of the Federal Government shall regulate the terms and
conditions of service of, officers and staff of the NSC Secretariat;
8. Conduct and discipline.‑The
Removal from Service (Special Powers) Ordinance, 2000 (XVII of 2000),
Government Servants (Efficiency and Discipline) Rules, 1973, the Government
Servants (Conduct) Rules, 1964 and all other rules and orders in this regard,
as amended from time to time, which are applicable to the civil servants, shall
apply, mutatis mutandis, to the employees of the Secretariat.
9. Right of appeal or
representation.‑The rules and instructions regarding appeals,
representations and petitions applicable to the civil servants, as amended from
time to time, shall apply, mutates mutandis, to the employees of the
Secretariat.
